text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Please! We really want you to play
in our next soccer match, Mira-ko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Well... I'm strictly a spectator.
I'm pretty slow, so I don't know...
I don't have a position I'm good at, either..."

Hishi Miracle was asked to fill in for a soccer match
due to a shortage of players. However, she seems
rather unconfident. In that case—
choice_data_list: How about the middle, where it won't affect offense or defense too much?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
In the middle... as in a midfielder!? Are you out of your mind?!
That's the team's playmaker, you know?
Isn't that a super important position?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Reading the flow, barking orders, shaping the game!
There's no way I can handle such an important position!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You know your stuff!
Mirako-chan, please play midfielder!
We'll cover you on the pitch!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah... Well, even if you say I'm an expert...
Ughhh, the mood makes it impossible to turn down...!

And on the day of the match, Hishi Miracle
was running across the field as a midfielder.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Mirako-chan, you've got this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Where are my allies...
there they are!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Take thaaat!!

Hishi Miracle kicked the ball vigorously toward her teammate.
However, it weakly fluttered off in a completely
unintended direction.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Aaah, sorry...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Don't sweat it! Let's move on to the next one!"

Afterward, the match continued
with neither team scoring any points—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*, *gasp*... Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Top Road is being marked so heavily
she can't make a move...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Besides, it's way too crowded on one side.
There's no room to move, and jockeying for position is draining stamina.
...At this rate... I'll lose.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh?
I feel like... I've seen things play out like this before......)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, they're getting too heated up and losing track of their surroundings...
They need to be more aware of the opposite side, too~.

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Why? Aren't we on the attack right now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Right. But look over at the opposite side. It's nothing
but enemies, right? If they pass over there,
they've got a straight shot right to the goal~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(That's the match I went to see with Dad...!
In that case――――!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Top Road-chan! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Mirako-chan is on the opposite side— ! ......Mirako-chan, pass!

On the completely open opposite side near the goal,
Hishi Miracle receives the ball.

Advancing across the empty field
with confident dribbling—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Top Road-chan! Pass coming your way!

"She kicked the ball into empty space.
Everyone thought it was yet another miskick...
Except for one person—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!!
(PIIIIIIIIIIIIIII!!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Yay, we did it~~!!
We actually did ittt!!
Thanks to their brilliant combination shot serving as the decider, the match ended in their victory that day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm so glad we won!
It was all thanks to your assist, Miracle-chan!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: That's not true. More importantly, how on earth did you manage to catch such a reckless pass?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I kinda felt like
Mirako-chan was planning
to pass the ball right then!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, me too~! I totally read your mind that passing it further ahead would be better!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! We really do hit it off
in the most mysterious ways, don't we?!
choice_data_list: Looks like you two will make a great team.
Looks like you two will make a great team, huh?
Do you know what we're both thinking right now?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! We really do hit it off
in the most mysterious ways, don't we?!
choice_data_list: Looks like you two will make a great team.
Looks like you two will make a great team, huh?
Do you know what we're both thinking right now?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right! I thought so too!
Please, please take care of me for the next match as well!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Aww, nah, it just happened to go well this time~...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah! If you don't want to be a player, how about being a coach? Your instructions were right on point!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I told you it's impossible~! I just want to watch
the match normally as a spectator~.
Overwhelmed by Narita Top Road's sheer momentum, Hishi Miracle found herself utterly at a loss.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that sounds fun~. Let's give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Could you read it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Then let's say it on three!
Ready, go—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
I'm so hungry~!
I'm so happy we won!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
……Is soccer the only time
we can truly understand each other, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ...It seems so, yes.

For some reason, soccer was the only time
they truly understood each other—a mysterious pair indeed.
